provenance: Original AI-generated artwork for Orbit Imperium. No third-party game artwork; screenshot references are project-owned visual studies. No trademark or logo assets generated.
recipe: Astronomical-atlas realism. Upper-right key light, navy shadows, champagne metals and ice-blue details. Complete silhouettes with transparent alpha, no baked text, UI, diagrams or game-state overlays. Art is decorative and supplies no gameplay facts.
